summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running anything (read-only verification only); nothing committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs; exports via __all__); UnderlineBar now yields one Text with clickable_ranges as trailing click spans and keeps the zero-width early path free of click metadata; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style via style + blended, preserving meta. Tests added: appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py; new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py and __init__.py. Docs page docs/reference/tabs.md and sandbox demo sandbox/tabs_demo.py + tabs_demo.css added. layout_resolve unchanged because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size, and fraction. Choices: bar position is a full-list index mapped to displayed tabs by name for duplicates; letter search only for single-character keys; empty tab name falls back to label. Known gaps: empty labels get a flexible zero-width edge (not special-cased); click-metadata tests assume rich's Style addition preserves meta, which I could not confirm against the installed rich. Tests were not run.
